method: Base/repaired/base/repaired on the same machine, release builds, all subprocesses pinned to CPU 3. Each round runs --parse 200000 (fastest of seven) then --read 200000 (fastest of five per command) with plain synthetic histories. BEAD_UNDER_TEST explicitly selects the matching saved bead executable; homes and remotes are scratch. Runtime commit/dirty fields name the checkout at execution, not the saved executable. Build provenance below identifies the executed code; the repaired input digest is unchanged in the final source even though documentation is added after measurement.

baseBuild.method: Base tracked contents restored in the original checkout, verified by git diff --quiet BASE; HEAD and index unchanged; restored immediately after compilation.

repairedBuild.inputDigestAlgorithm: SHA-256 of sorted records: repository-relative UTF-8 path, NUL, lowercase SHA-256 of file bytes, LF. Include regular files listed by git ls-files -- Cargo.toml Cargo.lock rust-toolchain.toml .cargo crates xtask.
